llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent for managing Prisma Access via SCM, but treat the SCM_CLIENT_ID and SCM_CLIENT_SECRET as sensitive secrets. Do not store them in plain shell history or source-controlled files; prefer a secure secret store. When following the SKILL.md, avoid logging full commands or request dumps that include Authorization headers or the raw token (the doc's suggestion to "log all changes" could accidentally leak tokens). Verify the GitHub homepage repository before trusting the skill (inspect any code if present there), ensure the client credentials have least-privilege access and rotate them regularly, and test operations in a non-production tenant or with dry-run checks before pushing configuration changes.
